 "data": "stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> PLANTED : Standard Order Created
 [*] --> WAITING_PLANTING : Pre-order Created
 
 WAITING_PLANTING --> PLANTED : [StartDate <= now AND Order == CONFIRMED]
 
 PLANTED --> GERMINATING : Staff plants seeds & confirms
 
 GERMINATING --> GROWING : [Days >= GerminationDays]
 GROWING --> READY_TO_HARVEST : [Days >= TargetHarvestDays]
 
 READY_TO_HARVEST --> HARVESTED : Staff HarvestAsync() / SoilTray -> MAINTENANCE
 
 state check_next_cycle <<choice>>
 HARVESTED --> check_next_cycle : NextCycleAsync()
 
 check_next_cycle --> PLANTED : [Delivery DELIVERED AND Has remaining cycles]
 check_next_cycle --> COMPLETED : [Final cycle finished]
 
 WAITING_PLANTING --> FAILED : Staff override
 PLANTED --> FAILED : Staff override
 GERMINATING --> FAILED : Staff override
 GROWING --> FAILED : Staff override
 READY_TO_HARVEST --> FAILED : Staff override
 
 FAILED --> [*]
 COMPLETED --> [*]",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 state CONFIRMED {

 DELIVERING --> CONFIRMED : Delivery DELIVERED, cycles remaining
 DELIVERING --> COMPLETED : All deliveries DELIVERED

 EXPIRED --> [*]
 COMPLETED --> [*]
